service_roles.label: USDA Food Safety Inspector
service_roles.description: Inspect meat, poultry and egg products every day, stopping foodborne illness before it reaches your grocery shelf.

service_roles.label: FDA Consumer Safety Officer
service_roles.description: Monitor how medicines, medical devices and cosmetics are made, so the health products you use are safe and effective.

service_roles.label: Public Health Scientist
service_roles.description: Track disease outbreaks and run the labs and studies that keep epidemics from spreading.

service_roles.label: OSHA Workplace Safety Inspector
service_roles.description: Inspect workplaces and enforce the rules that let millions of Americans come home safe from work each day.

service_roles.label: Social Security Claims Specialist
service_roles.description: Help retirees, people with disabilities and surviving spouses actually receive the benefits they earned.

service_roles.label: IRS Taxpayer Phone Representative
service_roles.description: Answer the phone when you call the IRS with a question about your return or your refund.

service_roles.label: IRS Revenue Agent
service_roles.description: Audit the most complex returns so the wealthiest taxpayers and corporations pay what they legally owe.

service_roles.label: FEMA Emergency Management Specialist
service_roles.description: Deploy the moment disaster strikes to coordinate shelter, food and aid so communities can rebuild.

service_roles.label: National Weather Service Meteorologist
service_roles.description: Forecast the hurricanes, tornadoes and floods whose warnings save lives and property.

service_roles.label: USGS Hydrologic Technician
service_roles.description: Measure the nation's rivers and groundwater to warn of floods and protect drinking-water supplies.

service_roles.label: Interior Biologist & Natural-Resource Specialist
service_roles.description: Protect wildlife, fisheries and the public lands that belong to every American.

service_roles.label: EPA Environmental Protection Specialist
service_roles.description: Run the programs that keep the air you breathe and the water you drink clean.

funding.basis: Sum of FY2024->FY2026 decreases in reported net budget authority (line 4180) across non-financing accounts, using the same values and continuity merges as the funding view. Defense cuts are included in the account total but reporting there is incomplete; the civilian-service topics below are the robust story.
